tasks.title: Design the divisor census: specified hypothesis + frozen contract

handoff.objective: Convert IDEA-20260831-df4197 into a specified hypothesis (H-AUXIN-66e6fd) and a frozen experiment contract (EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d) for the r-1/r+1 divisor census over the frozen standardized curve list, with planted-divisor positive control, safe-prime null control, arithmetic certificate checks, and a literature check on prior per-curve tables.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the divisor census is fully specified -- frozen curve list, exact cost expression, factorization certificates, controls, metrics, budgets, stopping rules -- so a later execution batch can run it without reinterpretation.
inputs: templates/research-records.md (hypothesis and experiment specification schemas; copy, do not invent fields)
docs/inventor-protocol.md (object-first generation, lossy-projection test already passed in the idea; null-object control before belief; Pareto honesty: dominated_by and sota_delta required)
ledger/ideas/IDEA-20260831-df4197.yaml (the proposal; follow its minimal_test design and controls exactly)

constraints: H-AUXIN-66e6fd status is specified, never approved: approval is the Coordinator's DEC-20260905-1c2b01 in this batch's ledger archive, not this task.

EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d is a frozen contract with approved_by null. Freeze the curve list in the contract (NIST P-224/P-256/P-384/P-521, secp256k1, brainpoolP256r1/P384r1, Ed25519 prime-order subgroup, BN254, BLS12-381 group orders). Budgets, stopping rules, required artifacts, and the run manifest shape are stated before any execution.

Carry the three controls from the idea verbatim into the contract: planted-divisor positive control (synthetic r with d = round(sqrt(r)) must return E(r) ~ 0.25), safe-prime null control (r-1 branch E(r) ~ 0.5), arithmetic product-recomputation control plus independent recomputation of every certificate by the run wrapper in a second arithmetic implementation.

Literature check first, via the knowledge retrieval policy: search for prior per-curve divisor tables before asserting unpublished novelty. Report contradictory sources rather than picking one. Every citation carries its provenance (recalled | retrieved | kb | internal); a recalled reference is a pointer, never support. Do not file KN-LIT rows here -- source filing belongs to execution; the design only records what was checked and what remains to file.
No ordinary-ECDLP improvement language anywhere: the goal's pause condition makes any such statement a supersede trigger. This census is pure integer arithmetic and claims no attack.

Stop-and-escalate: if the literature check or any preliminary arithmetic surfaces a near-sqrt(r) divisor on a deployed curve, STOP and report it as the terminal finding of this task; do not proceed to specify execution around it.
No status changes, no DEC/KN/EV records, no experiment runs. Preserve committed source records; write only the two exact artifact paths; never commit.
